articles.summary: Collaboration spans generative media, geospatial intelligence and agentic AI – with new solutions already deployed for clients including Duracell.
articles.title: Empowering the next creative frontier with AI research

articles.summary: WPP today announced the appointment of Baiju Shah as group Chief Strategy Officer. In this role, Baiju will help to accelerate delivery of the company's long-term strategy and unlock corporate development opportunities across WPP.
articles.title: WPP appoints Baiju Shah as group Chief Strategy Officer

articles.summary: WPP is expanding its long-standing partnership with Meta. WPP will become the first advertising partner to pilot Meta's new creative solution, built to navigate creative strategy and optimisation, currently in testing, for brands to analyse and suggest improvements for creative performance.
articles.title: WPP named first launch partner to pilot Meta’s newest creative solution, integrated within WPP Open

articles.summary: WPP today announces the creation of a dedicated communication and strategy operation designed exclusively for Natura, a leader in Beauty and Personal Care (BPC) in Latin America. This marks the first time Natura has consolidated its creative, media and production disciplines for both its brands under the management of a single strategic partner – a decisive step within a strategy to simplify and integrate its marketing operations in Latin America.
articles.title: WPP unifies Natura and Avon Communications in Latin America with a new dedicated operation

articles.summary: We unite cutting-edge media intelligence, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company. Powered by exceptional talent and WPP Open, our pioneering agentic marketing platform, we operationalise AI at scale.
articles.title: WPP Enterprise Solutions signs strategic collaboration agreement with AWS to operationalise agentic AI for leading brands

articles.summary: WPP dominates Cannes Lions 2026, with Ogilvy and VML named the top two creative networks. Discover how WPP’s integrated agencies won 140 Lions.
articles.title: WPP agencies triumph at Cannes Lions 2026, with Ogilvy and VML claiming the top two creative network honours

articles.summary: WPP today announced the launch of HEX, the company’s frontier studio built for the era of AI. Comprising of approximately 50 creative technologists from diverse backgrounds such as architecture, gaming, fine art and robotics, HEX operates at the intersection of innovation, imagination and craft.
articles.title: WPP launches HEX, creating a new kind of talent pipeline designed for the AI era
